mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.reporter_id AS reporterId, r.target_id AS targetId, u.user_name AS targetName, r.report_type AS reportType, r.reason, r.contents, r.report_status AS reportStatus, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM ctg_report r LEFT JOIN ctg_users u ON r.target_id = u.user_id WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
SELECT image_id, report_id, file_path, original_name, file_size, uploaded_at FROM ctg_report_image WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY image_id
